purpose: Automation and evidence matrix for apartment, building, and residential-complex search filters.

semantics.missing_value: unknown; never infer false, none, or zero from an absent source field
semantics.explicit_false: preserve false only when the source field is present and its documented value explicitly means false
semantics.price: base asking price is distinct from a conditional price; financing discounts/conditions are not merged into base price
semantics.price_per_sqm: canonical value may only be derived from an eligible total RUB asking price divided by positive total area_sqm; retain provenance of both inputs and formula; a vendor squarePrice remains raw source evidence and is not substituted
semantics.source_fields: preserve source fields losslessly, including fields not currently mapped

field_evidence_shape.value: typed scalar, array, object, or null
field_evidence_shape.scope: unit, offer, building, complex, or project
field_evidence_shape.observed_at: ISO-8601 timestamp with timezone for this field observation

provenance.inputs: for derived values, provenance entries for every input

semantics.fact_container: record.facts maps stable criterion keys to fact objects
semantics.price_per_sqm_value: exact ratio object {numerator_rub: integer, denominator_sqm: decimal-string}; unit RUB/m2; never round for filtering
semantics.freshness: field observed_at is ingestion/observation time; source_updated_at is retained separately. No source SLA is assumed. Apply the contract's offer-price freshness cutoff to offer prices only; refresh static features when source revision changes and re-evaluate stale status against an explicit as_of.

sources.name: Yandex Realty new-build YRL requirements
sources.access: feed must be provided by an authorized publisher; documentation does not grant access to any developer feed
sources.evidence: YRL spec describes price and discount (sections on deal terms), apartment attributes (section on living premises), and building attributes including built-year, ready-quarter, ceiling-height, lift, guarded-building, and parking. deal-status is sale/legal modality and not buyer payment method.

sources.name: bnMAP.pro GET Prices API
sources.access: personal pbi token required; paid/professional entitlement and terms must be verified by operator
sources.evidence: The method is the price-list data type. The response documents price as declared purchase budget and squarePrice as declared price per m²; create_time is collection date; numInPlatform is lot number on floor; start_sales is sales start; agreement is transaction contract type.

sources.name: ЕИСЖС / ДОМ.РФ API
sources.access: commercial/professional integration; exact API field schema could not be verified without authorized API documentation/access
supports: potential project/unit declaration characteristics, including area/rooms, energy-efficiency information, handover dates, parking-space counts; exact names and availability unverified
sources.evidence: Official integration information describes REST access to current system data; official 2023 API update describes expanded premises/building characteristics and energy-efficiency information. Do not infer an exact energy-class field without the authorized schema.

sources.name: Yandex new-build TSV registry/reference endpoint
sources.access: publicly reachable endpoint; public availability does not establish redistribution or rehosting rights
supports: reference labels/IDs only; not offers, prices, availability, or unit characteristics
sources.evidence: A bounded 4096-byte HTTP 206 metadata/sample inspection was recorded in data/property/yandex_tsv_sample.json; raw sample was not retained. Current normalizer preserves row columns and labels only.

sources.name: Минстрой России: открытые наборы реестров разрешений
sources.access: public machine-readable CSV/XLS releases; official reuse policy expressly permits copying, publishing, distributing, modifications, and commercial use when used lawfully, not distorted, and linked to source
supports: 2026-05-29 construction-permit snapshot: row number, EGRUL number, object name, developer, permit issue date, permit number
2026-05-29 commissioning-permit snapshot: row number, object name, applicant, permit issue date, permit number, EGRUL number
published title-based residential subset: 18 construction permit events and 9 commissioning permit events, all Sochi; zero explicit Moscow residential matches
two broad Moscow+housing-word narrative matches are gas-pipeline relocation events for a future residential microdistrict and are excluded from the housing layer
sources.evidence: Captured official 2026-05-29 XLS releases. Both workbooks have six columns: permit serial number, object name, applicant/developer, issue date, permit number, EGRUL number (column order differs). Residential title-prefix scan found 18 construction records and 9 commissioning records, all with explicit Sochi references and no explicit Moscow residential match. Two broader Moscow-plus-housing-term text hits describe gas-pipeline relocation events whose narrative refers to a future South Butovo microdistrict; both are retained for audit and excluded as non-residential object events. A record is a permit event, not a unique complex or active project. Neither workbook has structured address, construction start/completion dates, floor count, area, or apartment price. Original snapshots, hashes, field mappings, and reuse terms are recorded in data/property/minstroy/source_manifest.json and audit.json.

sources.name: Минстрой России: региональные/модельные ценовые benchmarks
sources.access: open-data reuse under Minstroy attribution/no-distortion terms
supports: historic aggregate market value per m²
historic average model-housing price per m²
sources.evidence: The Minstroy catalogue lists dataset 71 updated 2018-08-24 and dataset 98 updated 2020-12-03; these are aggregate benchmark price statistics, not price lists or sales offers.

sources.name: Аналитический центр Москвы: рынок недвижимости
sources.access: public summary page; site materials require prior approval for use; not cleared for rehosting
supports: aggregate market trend chart; page identifies CIAN as price-data source
does_not_support: offer-level price rows in an authorized downloadable format
sources.evidence: Official page credits CIAN for primary-market price series. Official content-use terms require prior agreement with the Analytical Center; no reuse is presumed.

criteria.automatic_feasibility: supported_from_authorized_feed_or_entitled_api; YRL only when currency is RUB/RUR and price unit is total; bnMAP price is asking/price-list evidence
criteria.evidence: YRL price.value plus currency/unit and optional discount.final-price; bnMAP price is documented as declared purchase budget. Keep conditional discounts as separate conditional price evidence, not the base asking total.
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown if absent, nonnumeric, currency/unit unsupported, or rights not cleared; never use booking/transaction values as current asking price
criteria.refresh: capture observed_at for every row; refresh on each authorized source snapshot; apply offer freshness cutoff from contracts

criteria.evidence: derive from eligible total RUB asking price and positive total area; bnMAP squarePrice and YRL area-priced value remain preserved as raw source fields and are not accepted as this canonical derived value
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown unless both eligible inputs exist; derived value must be exact ratio and identify both source fields, their observed_at/provenance, and formula; do not calculate from conditional total unless explicitly requested as a separate field
criteria.refresh: recompute whenever either input changes; retain input timestamps

criteria.evidence: YRL deal-status describes sale/legal modality; free-form description may mention mortgage but is not a documented structured payment-method field
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown unless an authorized structured source explicitly reports methods; never infer cash/mortgage/installment from deal-status, generic advertising text, or absence
criteria.refresh: refresh with each authorized offer snapshot

criteria.evidence: YRL floor and bnMAP floor identify the floor of the offered lot
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown if missing or invalid; do not infer from apartment number or building floors

criteria.automatic_feasibility: partially_supported; authorized bnMAP project parking_type may map only after reviewed value mapping; YRL parking boolean is not a type
criteria.evidence: bnMAP parking_type is at project scope. YRL parking is a boolean for presence of guarded parking, not underground/surface/none.
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown unless source explicitly supplies a mapped parking type; YRL parking=false does not prove no parking; absence is not none
criteria.refresh: on source revision; preserve source scope

criteria.evidence: YRL area.value/unit and bnMAP square are documented; EISЖС official summary describes premises area but exact fields are unverified
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown for absent, invalid, or unrecognized units; preserve raw unit and source field

criteria.evidence: YRL renovation tag has documented finish options; bnMAP interior is documented as finishing type at the building where the lot is located, while decoration fields may be lot-level
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown when omitted; do not map free text without a reviewed vocabulary; preserve source value and scope

criteria.evidence: YRL rooms is total room count but is not used for studios; bnMAP rooms is count; ЕИСЖС general official API note mentions premises rooms with exact schema gated
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown for missing/studio unless source explicitly reports studio separately; never coerce missing studio count to zero

criteria.evidence: YRL balcony values include balcony, loggia, and multiple balconies/loggias
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown if absent; do not infer no balcony

criteria.automatic_feasibility: partially_supported; only numeric bathroom-unit values directly provide count
criteria.evidence: YRL bathroom-unit accepts either combined/separate type or a numeric count
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown for omitted or type-only values; do not derive count from type

criteria.automatic_feasibility: partially_supported; only type-valued bathroom-unit directly provides type
criteria.evidence: YRL bathroom-unit accepts совмещенный or раздельный, alternatively a numeric value
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown for omitted or numeric-only values

criteria.evidence: YRL ceiling-height is defined in metres
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown if absent or invalid; do not substitute a floorplan estimate

criteria.evidence: YRL window-view values include courtyard, street, or both
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown if absent; do not infer from map orientation

criteria.automatic_feasibility: not_documented_as_count; YRL only supports lift presence
criteria.evidence: YRL lift is a boolean presence field; it has no elevator count
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown unless an authorized source provides explicit count; never convert lift=true to 1

criteria.evidence: YRL lift is a yes/no presence field
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown if omitted or invalid; preserve explicit false; never infer a count

criteria.evidence: Reviewed YRL new-build building fields document only lift presence, not passenger/freight counts or types
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown unless explicitly supplied by an authorized structured source

criteria.evidence: YRL guarded-building is explicitly defined as closed territory and supports yes/no values
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown if tag missing or unparsable; preserve explicit false; do not treat security staff as equivalent

criteria.evidence: YRL parking is presence of guarded parking; false does not establish that all parking is absent
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown if omitted or invalid; preserve explicit false; do not map false to parking_type=none

criteria.evidence: No reviewed YRL or bnMAP field establishes an onsite playground; marketing text/map context is not structured evidence
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown until an authorized source explicitly confirms presence or absence
criteria.refresh: manual/source revision review when a structured source becomes available

criteria.evidence: No reviewed new-build structured field specifically documents CCTV
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown unless an authorized structured source explicitly confirms presence or absence
criteria.refresh: manual/source revision review when a structured source becomes available

criteria.evidence: No reviewed new-build structured field specifically documents concierge service
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown unless an authorized structured source explicitly confirms presence or absence
criteria.refresh: manual/source revision review when a structured source becomes available

criteria.automatic_feasibility: not_documented_as_security_service; YRL guarded-building only describes closed territory
criteria.evidence: YRL guarded-building means closed territory and is not equivalent to security staff/service
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown unless a source explicitly documents building security; do not map closed territory to security

criteria.automatic_feasibility: not_supported_by_numInPlatform; requires explicit floor inventory/count field
criteria.evidence: bnMAP numInPlatform is documented as the lot number on a floor, not total apartment count on that floor
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown unless source explicitly provides a count; never infer from a lot's sequence number

criteria.evidence: No reviewed structured new-build YRL or bnMAP price-list field lists providers
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown unless an authorized, dated structured provider source supplies the list; preserve empty list only when explicit
criteria.refresh: refresh when the provider source revision changes

criteria.evidence: No reviewed YRL or bnMAP price-list field describes the installed stove type
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown unless an authorized structured source explicitly reports type; do not infer from utility/gas connection

criteria.evidence: bnMAP start_sales is sales start, not construction start; reviewed YRL completion fields do not specify construction start; EISЖС may contain project declarations but exact field unverified
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown unless an authorized source explicitly reports construction start date/year; never relabel sales start

criteria.evidence: YRL built-year/ready-quarter describe building handover/completion and key-handover-date is distinct; bnMAP dsc is planned commissioning date; EISЖС may contain handover data but exact field gated
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown when date absent/invalid; retain quarter/date precision and do not confuse key handover with commissioning
criteria.refresh: per source revision; update expected dates when new source snapshot appears

criteria.evidence: Official EISЖС API announcement confirms energy-efficiency information was added, but accessible public evidence does not confirm an exact energy_class field or class scale
criteria.unknown_policy: unknown until the authorized specification confirms field, scale, scope, and rights; do not infer from general efficiency descriptions

operational_boundaries: Do not fetch credentials, scrape private areas, or parse user-facing descriptions into structured buyer payment or amenity fields.
Do not use Yandex TSV reference labels as current inventory or as evidence of a sale offer.
A source observation may be retained locally for audit only when permitted; redistribution/public display requires explicit rights clearance.
Demo fixtures must be unmistakably synthetic and may not be imported into real/public inventory.

data_access_findings.offer_price_gap: No reviewed source currently provides both current unit-level asking-price rows and explicit rights for public rehosting in this application. Do not synthesize an Offer from aggregate benchmarks. Obtain an authorized developer feed/API agreement or a documented commercial license before importing real offers.

Request current field specification, permitted storage/public display, attribution, and rights for structured apartment/project fields. No message sent.

access_paths.path: Obtain an entitled account and personal pbi token from bnMAP; API docs require pbi and support test=true limited to 10 rows. Do not put token in CLI/logs; no token present.

Acquire feed directly from a participating developer with explicit rights to process/store/display the fields; YRL documentation is a publisher-feed specification, not permission to fetch another party feed.
